food-cityrepair-yanan-hele.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or unrelated dishes. Subject: Northern Shaanxi buckwheat hele noodles (荞面饸饹) as eaten in Yan'an: one rustic ceramic bowl of slender round brownish buckwheat noodles, pressed noodles of a consistent narrow cylindrical thickness and substantial length, partly visible above a modest warm savory broth, with a small helping of finely diced cooked lamb and chopped green scallions. Earthy brown noodle color, restrained red chili oil droplets. No flat ribbon noodles, no instant ramen curls, no Italian pasta, no raw ingredients around the plate.
